summary.en-US: Understand extension permissions and review meaningful changes without sending browser data anywhere.

release_notes.en-US: Permission Hound is the new name and visual identity for Extension Watchdog. The Firefox toolbar, popup, dashboard, and change notifications now use the new black-dog, checklist, and lock artwork, with an obsidian, silver, and violet visual theme. The add-on ID, requested permissions, local-only behavior, snapshots, and permission-change monitoring are unchanged.

version.approval_notes:
Version 0.1.4 renames the add-on from Extension Watchdog to Permission Hound. The existing add-on ID remains extension-watchdog@kahler2315.github.io so this is an update to the same AMO listing rather than a separate add-on.

The prior Watchdog shield PNGs are replaced with packaged Permission Hound artwork at 16, 32, 48, 96, and 128 pixels. The new artwork contains a black dog, a checklist, and a lock on an obsidian-and-violet shield. The popup and dashboard colors are updated to match the new visual identity.

The requested permissions remain management, storage, and notifications. There are still no host permissions and no content scripts. No network behavior, telemetry, remote service, or management mutation API was introduced. Automated tests pass, Mozilla lint reports 0 errors, warnings, and notices, and the listed-release source package builds successfully.
